evals.name: default-wayfinder-unchanged
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call the tracker. Chart and work a map using a default Jira setup with no jira-mapping.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the original wayfinder:map and wayfinder:<type> labels, native child/blocking relations where available, assignee claim, close behavior, and unchanged map semantics.
assertions: Uses the original map/type labels and native relationship defaults.
Uses original assignee claim and completion behavior.
Preserves destination, map, decision tickets, fog, frontier, and one-ticket-per-session.

evals.name: one-sparse-blocking-override
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira. jira-mapping.md contains only wayfinder.blocking mapped to the existing Depends on relationship. All other concepts are absent. Describe charting and frontier resolution.
evals.expected_output: Use Depends on only for blocking while retaining every original map label, ticket-kind label, child, claim, and close default.
assertions: Applies only the exact wayfinder.blocking override.
Retains original defaults for map marker, ticket kind, membership, claim, and completion.
Computes the same unblocked and unclaimed decision frontier.

evals.name: sparse-body-fallbacks
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira. Existing Jira lacks approved wayfinder labels and dependency links. Sparse rows map wayfinder.map, each wayfinder.kind.*, and wayfinder.blocking to documented body markers; membership and claim are absent. Describe the representation.
evals.expected_output: Use body markers only for mapped concepts, retaining the original child/sub-issue and assignee defaults for unmapped membership and claim.
assertions: Uses body fallbacks only for the explicitly mapped map, kind, and blocking concepts.
Keeps default native membership and assignee claim behavior.
Does not propose Jira labels, schema changes, or a generalized adapter mode.
